description:
`discord-to-msg` turns a Discord message event, as the WebhookBridge bot posts it, into the unified `msg` envelope and posts it into one of your UnitySVC rooms through the room connector named in the URL — the reverse of `msg-to-discord`.

WebhookBridge watches a Discord channel and POSTs each new message as JSON (`message`, `display_name`, `message_id`, `attachments`, …) to a URL of your choice. Pointed at this service, the gateway maps that event onto the `msg` fields a room takes — the text as `body` (Discord markdown kept as `markdown`), the attachment URLs, and an `origin` of `discord` carrying the Discord message id and the author's display name — and hands it to the platform's `rooms://post` upstream, which posts it into the room as the connector's member. The message id doubles as the idempotency key, so a redelivered event is not posted twice. Free.

Nothing to configure on the service: the room is named by the connector id in the URL, and the key rides in the URL too, so a sender that sets no headers can use it. In UnitySVC open Rooms → the room → Delivery → the connector, choose Discord to Messages as its inbound service, and give WebhookBridge the URL it shows (`https://api.svcpass.com/webhook/<KEY>/labs/discord-to-msg/<connector id>`) as the channel's destination. Keep that URL private: it carries a key that may post into the room. See “How to use this service” for the setup walkthrough.
name: discord-to-msg
summary: Bring Discord messages into a UnitySVC room: WebhookBridge posts each message here, the gateway converts it into a `msg` and delivers it through your room connector.
